review_evidence: Ran an Agda declaration-marker grep (module|data|record|postulate|field|open|import, line-start) across all 12 files: scores ranged from 7 (`src/Categories/Category.agda`) to 60 (`src/Categories/Category/Instance/Properties/Setoids/Exact.agda`); no zero-hit or near-empty file.

Read `src/Categories/Category.agda` in full (1730 bytes, lowest score, 7 markers): re-exports Categories.Category.Core, then defines infix notation `_[_,_]`/`_[_≈_]`/`_[_∘_]` and the `Definitions`/`Commutation` submodules with `CommutativeSquare` and a `connect` syntax combinator for commuting-diagram notation -- genuine formal interface content, not a pure aggregator.

Read `src/Categories/Object/Product/Morphisms.agda` in full (8951 bytes, 12 markers, lowest of the substantive files): defines and proves roughly 20 lemmas about morphisms between categorical products (`id×id`, `repack≡id×id`, `[_⇒_]×-cong₂`, `repack∘repack≈id`, `first-id`/`second-id`, `[_⇒_,_⇒_]first↔second`, etc.), each with a full equational proof via `begin ... ∎` reasoning -- genuine, substantial category theory.

No file in this unit matches the travis/index.agda exclusion pattern (already in force from the prior snapshot, not restated per the brief's instruction) or any other established exclusion precedent; the remaining 10 files hold real category-theory definitions and proofs (bicategories, binary/coproduct objects, Cartesian-closed categories, finite categories, posets, Setoids, unbundled-category utilities) consistent with the prior review's retain disposition.
